title: Rafael and the Vector
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Dominic Reyes, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
